description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaludemada, Kothmale D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District - Cad. Map No. 330308
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for specific parcels in various villages.
